request.user: {"question":{"id":"q04","question":"这副身体原主人苏天晴的死因是什么？","readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":21}},"mode":"source","remainingQueries":5,"answerRequired":false,"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":2,"query":"苏天晴"}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":21},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":6,"text":"吐掉嘴里的牙膏泡沫，苏天晴默默放下手中那只可爱的猫猫水杯与牙刷，双手撑住洗手池，抬起脑袋看向镜子里的金毛狐狐。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":17,"text":"与镜中的自己对视了半晌，苏天晴猛然察觉到自己这样的举动很像个变泰，脸颊微红，轻咳两声收敛发癫的状态，开始认真审视起自己身体中残留的记忆。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":18,"text":"这副身体的原主人就叫苏天晴，这里与自己曾经的世界相差无几，但却是人类与兽人共存的一个世界。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":20,"text":"虽然名义上共存，但兽人数量远远不及人类，苏天晴从小便独自一人孤独地长大，虽然模样可爱但社恐孤僻，好在有兽人互助协会的资助顺利考上蓉城最好的医学院，却又在临近开学时染上一场兽人流感，熬夜过程中突发了暴发性心肌炎……"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":21},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":4,"returned":4},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null}]}]}
